accountPanel_guestBlurb: You're playing as a guest. Sign in to keep your name on every device; guest play works the same either way.
accountPanel_termsNote: Signing in means you accept the terms of use.
trainingConsentField_description: Let the games you play while signed in be used, without your name, to train and test the computer opponents. Off unless you tick it; you can turn it off any time in account settings.
signinReturn_signupHint: Choose the name other players will see at the table. It doesn't need to be your real name.
signinReturn_saveError: Couldn't save. Check the name and try again.
signinReturn_failedBody: Google sign-in was cancelled or failed. You're still playing as a guest.
signinReturn_disabledBody: This account has been disabled, so it can't sign in. You can keep playing as a guest.
accountSettings_consentOn: Thanks: your games can help train the bots.
accountSettings_consentOff: Your games won't be used to train the bots.
accountSettings_exportDesc: Your account, your Google sign-in and the list of games you played, as a JSON file.
accountSettings_exportError: Couldn't download your data. Try again.
accountSettings_deleteDesc: Removes your account at once. Saved games keep your seat, without a link to you.
deleteAccountDialog_body: This can't be undone. You'll be signed out and play on as a guest.
deleteAccountDialog_confirmLabel: Type your display name, {name}, to confirm
deleteAccountDialog_error: Couldn't delete the account. Try again.
myGames_empty: No finished games yet. Games you finish while signed in show up here.
myGames_error: Couldn't load your games. Try again.
